description: Check a condition in the Telegram bot's syntax against live data and list the pairs that match now, strongest first. Syntax: metrics funding (%/h), cut (minutes to settlement), vol (24h volume, 1M = $1M), oi, plus ranges and presets — e.g. `funding>0.3 cut<30 vol>1M`, `hedge 0.3` (cross-exchange spread), `squeeze`, or a bare threshold `0.3`. Returns the exact `/watch` command the bot accepts, so the user can subscribe to future matches. Rates are predictions for the next settlement.

coin.description: Coin ticker (BTC) or any (default: any = the market's 300 strongest pairs)

condition.description: Bot condition, e.g. funding>0.3 cut<30 vol>1M, or a preset like hedge 0.3

lang.description: Language of the summary and links: 'en' (default) or 'ru'

name: condition_scan

data.description: Compact numbers the conclusion is based on, units named inside

link.description: Live page with the same data

title: Scan by a bot condition: what matches right now
